_comment: Probe42 API v1.3 endpoint registry, built from Probe42's official OpenAPI specs (company_*, llp_*, p&p_*, director_* yaml). {id} is replaced by the identifier (CIN / LLPIN / PAN / BID). Endpoints under 'data' use base_urls.data, endpoints under 'reports' use base_urls.reports. Set enabled=false on any entry to skip it.

base_details.description: Overview + authorized signatories/partners + open charges. Resolves CIN/LLPIN from PAN or BID.

data_status.description: Freshness: last_base_updated, last_details_updated, last_fin_year_end, last_filing_date, last_epfo_updated. Use to decide whether an update is needed.

comprehensive_details.description: Everything: financials+ratios, shareholdings, GST, EPFO, legal history, credit ratings, group entities, peer comparison, key indicators, probe financial score. 404 'not probed yet' means call update first.

update.description: Async full data refresh / first-time probe. Returns request_id; poll get_update_status until FULFILLED.

update_basedata.description: Async refresh of base data only (company, signatories, charges); usually done in minutes.

update_documents.description: Async download of MCA documents into Probe; poll get_update_status.

get_update_status.description: Status of an async request: REQUESTED -> FULFILLED.

director_details.description: Director profile by DIN or PAN: DIN status, DSC status/expiry, nationality, address.

director_network.description: All current and past company/LLP directorships of a director.

report_pdf.description: Curated comprehensive report (type=pdf). Needs a prior full update. format=base64 returns a base64 string.

incorporation_document.description: Latest AoA / MoA / CoI / INC20A (company) or CoI (LLP) as PDF via a 30-second signed S3 redirect.

document_by_id.description: Any MCA reference document by doc_id found in comprehensive-details metadata (30-second signed S3 redirect).

search._comment: Legal-name search is referenced by Probe42's error catalogue ('Search string length must be more than three characters') but its spec was not in the bundle. Path below is the probe_lite convention; set it to what your API portal shows, or search by name on business.probe42.in and pass the CIN.
